mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 5.

Polish constitutional crisis escalates, President Karol Nawrocki calls urgent talks with parliamentary party leaders after the Constitutional Court dispute.

Protesters in Pristina continued demonstrations demanding institutional accountability for the killing of 49-year-old Arlinda Zekaj in Vitomirica, Peja.

Manchester City suffered a surprising 1-0 home defeat to Brighton, with the only goal scored in the 11th minute.

Albanian-born pop star Dua Lipa won a major legal battle, bringing her estimated net worth to about £150 million.

Official line-ups for the German Bundesliga clash between Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund have been released, revealing the selected players for both sides.
